title: Kathleen Camilli (NACD Governance Fellow) ahead of the Directors Summit — 'Best practices are the bane of an independent directors existence when they don't represent all the stakeholders'
summary: A sitting independent director with 25 years of public and private board experience flags Eric's upcoming NACD mainstage session, and names the problem she wants it to address: the governance best practices directors are handed can fail the stakeholders they are meant to serve and collide with the founder's mission.
blockquote: Best practices are the bane of an independent directors existence when they don’t represent all the stakeholders, and conflict with the founders mission, but there are solutions!
attribution_title: Independent Director · NACD Leadership and Governance Fellow · Economist
